No register is read on entry, no stack word is named, and the terminal is a bare RET (c3) with no immediate, so the callee pops nothing. ECX is written at 0x00b5b809 purely to feed the tail jump, so it is not a receiver. With zero parameters and zero register receiver the body is byte-identical under __cdecl, __stdcall, __thiscall and __fastcall; the macro PKG_00B5B800_CALL is present, named, and carries no convention token.

semantic_findings.basis: 8b 41 20 dereferences ECX directly. A virtual dispatch would require a second load through [ECX]; none occurs, and no call is made after the load.

summary: No-argument, no-receiver, bare-RET forwarding accessor, 20 bytes / 7 instructions: CALL 0x00b3d320 (MOV EAX,DS:0x0167eaec) reads a borrowed global; TEST EAX,EAX gates the whole 32 bits; the non-null arm MOV ECX,EAX then TAIL-JUMPs to 0x00a42730 (MOV EAX,DWORD PTR [ECX+0x20]) so the field reader's RET is this root's return; the null arm does OR EAX,imm8 with imm8 ff, which sign-extends to 0xffffffff. Two memory reads, zero stores, no allocation/lock/refcount, 4-byte return. +0x20 is a displacement over an OPAQUE byte run -- not a struct member, not a vtable load, not a dispatch. The result stays std::uint32_t; the 0xffffffff sentinel is never normalised to pointer null and the 0x01654c00..06 consumer family is kept a separate domain. Confirms prior art (docs/analysis/simulator-root-closure.md, knowledgegraph/research/root-closure-f0e310e0.json per_root[2]) in full. NEW corroboration: 0x00ad12a0 contains both spellings of the same forwarded field in one function body -- inlined 0x00ad1f3e..0x00ad1f4a (call 0x00b3d320 / mov ecx,eax / call 0x00a42730 / cmp eax,0x01654c05, arm sets bit 0x100) and the call spelling at 0x00ad1f63 (call 0x00b5b800 / cmp eax,0x01654c04, arm sets bit 0x200) -- which is what establishes the root and the inlined read return the SAME word. COVERAGE: 0x00b5b800 IS inside the canonical 58,757-row universe (verified against knowledgegraph/research/21-decompilation-coverage.json#ledger; membership True), unlike the four listed exclusions 00b5b880/00b5b8a0/00b5b8c0/00b5b8e0 in coverage.json#reconstruction.out_of_universe, which are all False. No silent workaround was needed.
